[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Tarrik''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] within the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]]. By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Tarrik commanded [[Nomad Squadron]], based aboard the [[MC80B Star Cruiser]] ''[[Allegiant]]'' patrolling the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] for signs of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] activity. The captain earned a reputation for forming the squadron into an exceptional fighting force with the versatility to perform missions planetside as well as in space.<ref name="Gamer 9" />
